ValidationRule.description: Returns an error if Yes is selected in the Is this staff member replacing another field, but no member is selected.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR(ISBLANK( Name_of_staff_member_being_replaced__c ) , ISBLANK( Date_to_Deactivate_Previous_Staff__c ),ISPICKVAL( Reason_for_Deactivation__c,'')), ISPICKVAL( Is_this_staff_member_replacing_another__c ,"Yes"))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You must choose the name of the ACTIVE CHATS staff member that is being replaced, and complete the "Date to deactivate previous staff member" and "Reason for Deactivation" fields.
